# tebin-style

> Brand kits for AI agents and people: W3C DTCG design tokens, logos as SVG
> **and pre-rendered PNG** (for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and any tool that
> cannot embed SVG), plus machine-readable design rules. Every URL below is a
> direct, permanent raw link. Fetch it as is — no release download needed.

> **The wordmark is a file, never text.** Its letters are drawn outlines, not a
> font, so typing “TEBIN” in Roboto or any other face does not reproduce the
> logo — it produces different letterforms. Download one of the PNGs below and
> insert it as an image. For Word, Excel and PowerPoint that is the whole job.

## Logos (PNG — use these for documents and Office files)

- [TEBIN Classic logo 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-1024.png): two-colour wordmark, transparent
- [TEBIN Classic logo white, on red 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-white-1024-on-brand.png): for red backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic logo white, on charcoal 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/logo-full-white-1024-on-charcoal.png): for dark backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic corner mark 512 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/png/corner-mark-512.png): the mark on its own
- [TEBIN (web theme) logo 1024 px](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/assets/png/logo-full-1024.png): web variant

Other sizes follow the same pattern, 128 to 2048 px: `logo-full-512.png`,
`logo-full-2048.png`, `corner-mark-128.png`, `corner-mark-256.png`.

## Logos (SVG)

- [TEBIN Classic logo SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/logo/logo-full.svg): light backgrounds
- [TEBIN Classic logo white SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/assets/logo/logo-full-white.svg): dark or red backgrounds
- [TEBIN (web theme) logo SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/assets/logo/logo-full.svg)

## Themes

Three themes ship here.

- **tebin-classic** — the 2017 print-era identity: Pantone red and grey, Roboto
  with an Arial fallback. Use it for documents and anything printed. Tokens at
  `themes/tebin-classic/dist/`.
- **tebin** — the web theme: red on charcoal, translucent scales, plus the type
  and spacing scales used on tebin.pro. Tokens at `themes/tebin/dist/`.
- **slate** — a neutral starter for projects that are not TEBIN.
  **Tokens only, no logo assets.** MIT. Tokens at `themes/slate/dist/`.

Each `dist/` holds `tokens.css`, `tailwind.css`, `tokens.dtcg.json`,
`theme.ts` and `colors.csv`.

Tokens are grouped as `color`, `role`, `font`, `radius` and — on `tebin` —
`type`, `lineHeight`, `fontWeight`, `spacing` and `layout`. A **role** points
at a palette colour instead of copying it, so `role.surface` resolves through
`color.paper`.

**Red text takes a different red.** `#DA291C` clears 4.5:1 on neither a dark
nor a light surface, and no red does. Small red text uses `brand-on-dark`
(`#EA6359`) or `brand-on-light` (`#C7251A`).

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Full asset index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/registry/index.json): every theme and asset, SVG and all PNG sizes, with direct `rawUrl` fields
- [Design rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/rules/dist/rules.md): 62 MUST / SHOULD / NEVER rules, most with the reason they exist
- [Colour table (CSV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/dist/colors.csv): RGB for Word and Excel

## Design guides

One self-contained page per theme: palette with RGB and print values, roles,
type, spacing, assets and rules. Every link inside is absolute, so the file
still works when pasted into a chat.

- [TEBIN Classic DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin-classic/DESIGN.md)
- [TEBIN DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/tebin/DESIGN.md)
- [Slate DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4aykas/tebin-style/main/themes/slate/DESIGN.md)
